## About
Bastone Auto Service started when James S Bastone, known as The Chief, bought Groetzinger's Amoco on South Highland Ave, where he had worked on cars before serving in World War II. His sons Jim and Frank worked at the station after school, and the family has been fixing cars for the East Liberty/Shadyside area ever since.
When the shop left the gas business, The Chief bought the building we're in now, the old Carron Street Baptist Church, practically behind the original location. Over the years his youngest son Bob joined, bringing an electronics background just as cars started carrying onboard computers, and later Frank's son Carl came on. Larry Segal has been part of the shop too.
We handle common maintenance for cars and light trucks, from oil changes and PA State inspections to advanced diagnostics on the electronic systems. Most of our new customers come to us by word of mouth. Come see why that is.

## Services
- PA State safety inspection: State safety inspections for your car or light truck. One reviewer mentioned easy scheduling over email.
- PA State emissions testing: Emissions testing done right here in the shop.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes as part of regular maintenance.
- Tire Sales - All brands: We sell tires from all brands.
- Tire rotation: Rotating your tires to help them wear evenly.
- Installation and remove of snow tires: We'll put your snow tires on for winter and take them off when it's over.
- Perform scheduled maintenance to satisfy manufacturer warranty requirements: Scheduled maintenance done to meet your manufacturer's warranty requirements.
- All brake work: Brake work on your car or light truck.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: We do sometimes take walk-in customers, but we strongly recommend making an appointment. A phone call or an email is all it takes.

Q: What makes and models do you work on?
A: Virtually all of them, foreign and domestic, including VW, Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Volvo, Honda, Toyota and many more.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, from 7:30 in the morning until 5 in the afternoon.
